record.question: For a semiconductor, which one of the following statements is NOT correct?
options: When an electron and hole recombine, energy must be liberated
Electrons in the conduction band can acquire a net acceleration from a field because there are empty energy levels available
An electron in the valence band cannot be accelerated by the field unless there are empty energy levels available
Holes cannot be accelerated by the field unless there are empty energy levels available
